note: Knob DIFF over the base puzzle-text (tx5 paired contained-scatter converge). The base owns the word-level split, the always-opaque words (zero layout shift), the transform+color assembly, the ONE air ease and the reduced-motion/narrow static fallback. This variant's engine (variant.js) ADDS a real Z-depth assemble: whole word-blocks WAIT scattered in CSS perspective Z-depth (near large+blurred+dim, far small) and CONVERGE home from depth, de-blurring gray->ink. Byte-faithful to tx3-word-blocks-depth.html.

engine.model: depth-converge (Z-fly-in for text) — whole word-blocks wait in real CSS perspective Z-depth then converge to z=0, blur=0, gray->ink
engine.depthSplit: zNorm>0.5 => near half (toward viewer, +z, big+blurred+dim); zNorm<=0.5 => far half (away, -z, small+distant+lighter)
engine.blur: BLUR_MAX * (0.30 + 0.70 * (near? zNorm : nearness*0.7))   near words = blurrier DOF, capped <=20px
engine.scatterOffset: both-axis radial: x = cos(ang)*rad*innerWidth*spreadX, y = sin(ang)*rad*innerHeight*spreadY  (rad 0.35..1.0)
engine.colorRamp: lerp #2A2622 -> (near #615B52 / far #7E776B) on the way in; seats to --type-ink (or --bronze for .pt-em accent words)
engine.cue: thin filling progress line (scaleX 0->1), NOT a count-up

skin.serif: Fraunces, Times New Roman, Georgia, serif
skin.typeInk: #F3ECE0 (seated warm ink on the dark field)
skin.render: quiet QUADRO aerial behind, opacity 0.16, desaturated — never the star
skin.fallback: static .fallback statement block for reduced-motion / narrow
